evidence: 1) Agent image: task/environment/Dockerfile sha256 0a75419e...67d1 is byte-identical to the frozen template environment/Dockerfile. It installs only OS packages plus express@5.1.0/better-sqlite3@12.4.1 (lines 5-12), COPYs only instructions/ and assets/ (lines 14-15), and creates /app with git init + an empty .gitkeep committed (lines 17-23). No COPY of solution/ or tests/. The build context environment/ contains only Dockerfile, assets/seed_data.json, instructions/hireops_rules.md, instructions/integration.md (ls -a: no hidden files). task.toml [environment] has no docker_image (lines 20-24), so no prebuilt image can shadow this. 2) No starter or partial deliverable: no JS/HTML/CSS/SQL/schema/route list exists anywhere in environment/. integration.md only states the runtime contract (template text plus a symlink-delivery paragraph). It explicitly leaves routes/layout to the agent (line 14). hireops_rules.md lines 3-5 say "Routes, field names, element ids, button labels and the shape of the pages are yours". It is a behavioural business-rules spec (roles, stage rules, concurrency, conversations, candidate wording), which is input and the ask, not a finished deliverable. 3) Seed: environment/assets/seed_data.json (sha a1c65c80...3740) holds raw records only: generated_note, stages, candidate_status_labels, thread_page_size, users(10), jobs(3), applications(16), messages(127), notes(3), reads(6 read_count markers). It contains no derived/expected outputs (unread counts, seen states, activity lines, expected orders after moves). It equals solution/app/src/seed_data.json byte for byte, which is the intended copy of the input, not leakage of solution logic. 4) Grader text: grep for judge|rubric|criteri|dimension|reward|weight|score.py|playwright|glm|claude|/tests|sentinel|probe over instruction.md and environment/instructions returned no hits. A word 10-gram overlap scan between brief+rules and every tests/**/*.md and *.toml found 0 shared 10-grams. At 7 words, functional/prompt.md (3376 words) shares a single phrase, 'the card was changed and by whom', a public requirement restated in the criterion. tests/ is only built into the separate verifier image (tests/Dockerfile:43 COPY . /tests; environment_mode = "separate"). Adversarial check: a weak app cannot gain anything from the environment because nothing executable or UI-shaped is shipped; any agent must build the whole server/UI from an empty /app. No conforming alternative is disadvantaged by the environment. Limitation: I did not build or inspect the agent image at runtime (no Docker per assignment). The image contents follow deterministically from the template-identical Dockerfile, the public base image and the pinned npm packages, so this does not leave a required measurement missing for this row.
